episodes.title: Forget Me Not
episodes.summary: A cut-throat corporate shark prides himself on his vivid memory until an encounter with a woman he can't recall sends him down a vortex of self-doubt.

episodes.title: Bahrupiya
episodes.summary: When a timid makeup artist begins making and using prosthetics to get back at those he feels wronged by, his masks could be his armor – or his undoing.

episodes.title: Hungama Hai Kyon Barpa
episodes.summary: When a singer with kleptomaniac tendencies encounters the victim of one of his thefts years later, his restitution attempt doesn't go quite as planned.

episodes.title: Spotlight
episodes.summary: A popular but creatively unsatisfied actor grapples with his growing insecurities as another icon's dazzling aura threatens to dim his star.
